About this item

  • SEMI-TRANSPARENT WATER RESERVOIR holds up to 4 cups of water capacity with a level indicator to always ensure you have enough water ready for brewing.
  • 4 CUP GLASS CARAFE for brewing the perfect quantity of hot fresh coffee for an individual or a small group of people.
  • PAUSE 'N SERVE allows a quick pour of fresh coffee in the middle of the brewing cycle if you're running low on time or just need a quick coffee fix.
  • KEEP WARM FUNCTION automatically turns on when brewing to keep your coffee hot & fresh.
  • RE-USABLE FILTER with removable filter basket is easy to clean and better for the environment by reducing the need for paper cone filters.

Product Description

Start your day off with the Elite Gourmet 4-Cup Automatic Coffeemaker. It’s compact and has a sleek design that takes up minimal counter space & stores easily when not in use. It’s perfect for small spaces such as office kitchens, dorm rooms or recreational vehicles. Quickly and effortlessly brew your favorite coffee to jump start your day or for an extra cup anytime. No need to stop at a local coffee house to buy a cup of joe just to make it through the day. Enjoy your favorite ground coffee without paper filters by using the included reusable filter. Simply add desired amount of fresh water for each brew. Cleanup is a cinch; all removable parts and accessories are top-shelf dishwasher safe. Enjoy a fresh, hot & delicious cup of joe on the go with the Elite Gourmet 4-Cup Automatic Coffeemaker.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find the coffee maker easy to use and convenient, particularly appreciating its compact size for small spaces and single-person use. The brew quality receives positive feedback, with customers saying it makes great coffee and heats up quickly. However, the durability is concerning, with multiple customers reporting it broke down within 8 months, and there are issues with leakage, with water spilling onto the warming plate. While some customers find it worth the price, others consider it a waste of money, and the coffee temperature receives mixed reviews, with some saying it keeps coffee very hot while others find it lukewarm.

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
great LITTLE coffee maker
I knew this was tiny when I ordered it. I am not a fan of pods. I have done French press for single-serve. But I wanted a drip maker I could use a paper filter with (this takes #2 cone filters...or the included "permanent" filter, which is not the same as a paper filter, but I digress). But this is perfect for me ... their "four cups" makes just slightly more than a mug of coffee. See the photo. And that's not a huge mug. If you like drip coffee, but don't want to brew enough for the Waffle House, this is for you. Good value. UPDATE: Now that I've had this awhile, not taking away any stars, but there are a couple things to note. As some other reviewer(s) have mentioned, you can't use the power switch without holding the unit down with your other hand. It requires too much pressure, and the unit is too light. The decanter is miniature in every way, including the pouring lip. So if you think you have to pour slowly from your full-size decanter that doesn't have a wide lip, you really have to slow down with this. When will product designers learn? EVERYONE likes a wide lip on the decanter, not just servers. NOBODY likes the little narrow ones. We're pouring into mugs, not espresso cups. And finally, the "sneak a cup" feature on this doesn't really work ... it continues to drip. I think maybe the spring is too weak, but it also could be the gasket isn't pliable/wide enough. But if you can't wait for this tiny little batch to brew, you are really jonesing. Anyway, still five stars, because, look at the price.

    I really like this coffee maker. I've been using it every day for about three months, and it has worked perfectly without any issues.

    One of my favorite features is the reusable filter. It helps reduce waste, and I like not having to buy or throw away paper filters. The size is also perfect for one or two people. It makes just the right amount of coffee for my morning routine, and I can easily take some with me to work.

    This is a simple coffee maker, but that's exactly what I was looking for. I enjoy starting my day with a hot cup of coffee, and bringing coffee from home has helped me save a lot of money by not buying coffee every day. Personally, I like to drink my coffee black, so I'd rather spend my money on high-quality coffee beans than on expensive coffee drinks.

    Overall, I highly recommend this coffee maker. It's affordable, reliable, easy to use, and perfect for anyone who wants a simple machine that makes great coffee every day.

    I bought this to replace an older 12 cup maker that unfortunately stopped working.

    While significantly smaller, this one does what it's supposed to just fine. It looks good on my counter, doesn't take up much space. Other people have commented about the temperature of the brew, and they're right. It doesn' brew as hot as my previous one, though for me personally that's not an issue. I usually had to let a cup sit and cool down a bit before whereas now, once I put some milk in it's the perfect temperature.

    The only issue I have with it is that due to the small size, it takes a bit to get used to pouring it slowly so as not to spill all over the counter. This is more of a learning issue as opposed to an actual problem. I would however caution anyone with more than one coffee drinker in the household, get a bigger one than this. lol.

    All in all, for what I paid, no real complaints.

About this Item

  • SEMI-TRANSPARENT WATER RESERVOIR holds up to 4 cups of water capacity with a level indicator to always ensure you have enough water ready for brewing.
  • 4 CUP GLASS CARAFE for brewing the perfect quantity of hot fresh coffee for an individual or a small group of people.
  • PAUSE 'N SERVE allows a quick pour of fresh coffee in the middle of the brewing cycle if you're running low on time or just need a quick coffee fix.
  • KEEP WARM FUNCTION automatically turns on when brewing to keep your coffee hot & fresh.
  • RE-USABLE FILTER with removable filter basket is easy to clean and better for the environment by reducing the need for paper cone filters.

Product Description

Start your day off with the Elite Gourmet 4-Cup Automatic Coffeemaker. It’s compact and has a sleek design that takes up minimal counter space & stores easily when not in use. It’s perfect for small spaces such as office kitchens, dorm rooms or recreational vehicles. Quickly and effortlessly brew your favorite coffee to jump start your day or for an extra cup anytime. No need to stop at a local coffee house to buy a cup of joe just to make it through the day. Enjoy your favorite ground coffee without paper filters by using the included reusable filter. Simply add desired amount of fresh water for each brew. Cleanup is a cinch; all removable parts and accessories are top-shelf dishwasher safe. Enjoy a fresh, hot & delicious cup of joe on the go with the Elite Gourmet 4-Cup Automatic Coffeemaker.
